title: Implement GET and PUT /api/settings routes
description: Create the API routes for reading and updating application settings. Settings are stored as key-value pairs in the settings table.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/settings returns all settings as a flat object
PUT /api/settings accepts a flat object and updates all provided keys
API keys in responses are partially masked (show last 4 chars only)

steps.details: Export GET and PUT handlers. GET: load all settings from repository and return as `{ key: value }` object. Mask sensitive keys (anthropic_api_key, pexels_api_key, resend_api_key): show `****{last4}`.
Parse body as `{ [key: string]: string }`. For each key, call `upsertSetting(key, value)` from repository. Return 200 with the updated (masked) settings.
GET /api/settings. PUT /api/settings with a new email_mode. GET again and verify the change persisted.
